An Industry Breakdown Watch now View all posts FAQ How does retail chargeback software work? Retail chargeback software works by automating the dispute lifecycle, specifically targeting first-party fraud and delivery disputes. The platform gathers retail-specific evidence, such as proof of delivery and transaction history, to validate legitimate purchases. This technology submits data-driven responses to banks, effectively recovering revenue that would otherwise be lost due to buyer's remorse or confusion. What is first-party fraud and why is it such a problem for online retailers? First-party fraud, AKA friendly fraud or first-party misuse, is when your actual customer disputes a charge they legitimately made. Maybe they forgot about the purchase, didn't recognize the billing descriptor, or simply changed their mind and found a chargeback easier than a return. Unlike stolen card fraud, these people did order from you, did receive the product, and still filed a dispute. It's maddening because you did nothing wrong. Justt helps by pulling the evidence that proves the transaction was legitimate: delivery confirmation to the customer's address, their purchase history with you, IP matching, and any communications where they acknowledged receipt. Banks need to see proof the customer got what they paid for, and Justt builds that case automatically. A customer claims they never received their order, but tracking shows it was delivered. Can Justt help me win that dispute? This is one of the most common eCommerce disputes, and yes, it's winnable with the right evidence. Tracking data alone isn't always enough. Banks want to see delivery confirmation to the cardholder's address, signature if available, photo proof of delivery, and ideally a match between the shipping address and billing address. Justt connects with your logistics providers to pull this documentation automatically and formats it according to what each card network requires. If the customer has a history of similar claims, we include that pattern too. Chargebacks spike during the holidays. How does Justt handle seasonal volume? Peak season is rough. Your order volume jumps, and a few months later the disputes follow. Most teams can handle their baseline dispute load, but when volume doubles or triples, cases slip through the cracks. Deadlines get missed. Justt scales automatically because there's no manual work per case. Whether you're dealing with 50 disputes a month or 500, the platform processes them the same way. You don't need to hire seasonal staff or watch your win rate collapse because your team is overwhelmed. What happens if my chargeback ratio gets too high? Nothing you want to experience. Visa and Mastercard both monitor merchant dispute rates, and crossing their threshold around 0.9% to 1% of transactions depending on the card network) lands you in a monitoring program. That means extra fees, mandatory reporting, and pressure to fix the problem fast. Go higher and you risk the MATCH list, which is a shared database that makes it nearly impossible to get approved by other processors. Some retailers have lost their ability to accept cards entirely. Justt helps keep your ratio healthy by recovering revenue on disputes you'd otherwise lose, and our insights dashboard tracks exactly where you stand. How much time does fighting eCommerce chargebacks actually take? More than most teams budget for. Each dispute needs delivery records pulled from your shipping provider, transaction details from your payment processor, customer communication logs, and sometimes return policy screenshots or product photos. Someone has to compile all of that, format it correctly for the card network, and submit before the deadline. Miss that window and you lose automatically. For a mid-sized retailer handling a few hundred disputes monthly, we're talking 20 or 30 hours a week of someone's time. Justt takes that off your plate by connecting to your systems and handling evidence gathering, formatting, and submission without manual effort. An Industry Breakdown Watch now Event Ticketing Chargebacks: How to Fight Back Watch now Chargebacks for Merchants: 10 Features to Look for in a Management Solution Watch now View all posts FAQ Why does event ticketing attract so many chargebacks compared to other industries? Tickets are time-sensitive, high-emotion purchases. Someone buys floor seats on impulse, regrets the price two days later, and files a dispute instead of dealing with your refund policy. Plans change, the event sells out, and suddenly they "don't recognize" the charge. Secondary market transactions add another wrinkle: buyers claim tickets were fake or never delivered, even when scans prove otherwise. Justt pulls delivery confirmations, venue scan data, and event records to prove the ticket was real and used. A customer attended the event. Their ticket was scanned at the venue. Can they still win a chargeback? They try. And without the right evidence, they sometimes succeed. Banks don't automatically know your ticket was scanned at the door. You need to show that chain clearly: delivery confirmation to their email, the scan timestamp at the venue matching the event date, and any communications where they acknowledged receipt. Justt compiles this documentation automatically and formats it so dispute analysts can follow the logic without understanding how ticketing platforms work. How do I fight ticket chargebacks from secondary market purchases? Secondary transactions are messy because the original buyer and the person who attended are often different people. The cardholder claims fraud, but someone used that ticket at the show. Winning these disputes requires connecting the dots: proof the ticket was delivered to the purchaser's email, transfer records if it was resold through your platform, and scan confirmation showing the ticket was valid and used. Justt pulls these records and builds the case showing the original transaction was legitimate. Event cancellations and postponements trigger floods of disputes. How do we manage that volume? A canceled headliner or rescheduled date can generate hundreds of disputes in a week. Your normal process falls apart when suddenly every buyer from a single event decides to file a chargeback rather than accept a credit or wait for the new date. Justt handles the surge automatically. Evidence collection, policy documentation showing refund options offered, and submission all happen without your team scrambling to meet deadlines. Our refund policy is strict and clearly posted. Does that actually help win disputes? Policy language matters, but presentation matters more. Banks want to see that the customer agreed to your terms at checkout, that those terms were clear about non-refundable purchases, and that you offered whatever alternatives your policy promised. Justt captures the policy the customer accepted, timestamps showing when they agreed, and records of any credits or exchanges you offered after they complained. What's the real cost of a ticketing chargeback beyond the face value of the ticket? You lose the ticket revenue, pay the chargeback fee, and if the event already happened, that seat went empty or was resold. High-volume ticketing operations face the added risk of ratio problems. Too many disputes and you're dealing with monitoring programs, extra processor fees, or threats to your merchant account right before a major on-sale. Justt helps recover revenue on disputes while keeping your ratio healthy. Which payment processors and ticketing platforms does Justt support? Over 40 PSPs work with Justt out of the box, including processors common to ticketing operations. Direct integrations with ticketing platforms pull delivery records, scan confirmations, and event data automatically. If you're using a system we don't already support, adding it is straightforward. How does Justt mitigate chargebacks? Justt is an AI-native solution that automates every aspect of chargeback management – from collecting evidence to A/B testing submissions. jobs.description: Skip to content Blog Guides Why customers choose Justt over Chargeflow For merchants, chargeback management solutions are essential for recovering revenue and reducing the impact of chargebacks on their bottom line. But with so many options available, selecting the right one can be a challenge. While you may have made the decision to automate your chargebacks, it’s difficult to tell the difference between the different solutions. Even solutions that make similar “automation” promises differ significantly in terms of quality, reliability, and the net dollar amount of revenue recovered (which is the chargebacks won minus labor, fees and technology investment). In this article, we’ll take a closer look at two popular options—Justt and Chargeflow—helping you decide which is the best fit for your business. The TL;DR: Justt and Chargeflow both offer fully automated chargeback disputes. Chargeflow is a younger and less capitalized startup (founded in 2021), primarily serving smaller e-commerce and direct-to-consumer merchants. Chargeflow is very easy to install and get started on Shopify. It has a strong focus on the Shopify ecosystem, although Justt’s Shopify solution with its dynamic arguments technology may offer better results and a similar ease of use. While both companies use AI in their solutions, Justt has pioneered these capabilities and benefits in the chargeback management market. Its solution is based on access to data from millions of disputes across different industries. Justt is also the only solution in the market to offer dynamic arguments – it doesn’t use templates at all, but collects the data for each dispute and builds the optimal evidence, argument by argument and A/B tests it all. Justt has strong expertise in the chargeback space, with a deep understanding of the different rules and requirements. This is combined with its solution, ensuring that every industry change is immediately reflected in what the system creates, whether by industry, issuer, reason code and more, delivering economies of scale to its customers. Justt has more integrations with PSPs and other players. Together with its strong reporting and analytics capabilities, Justt provides large companies the tools they need to manage chargebacks. Justt also has a strong focus on enterprise grade security that is required by large accounts. Chargeflow While Chargeflow claims full automation and AI-powered capabilities, it is unclear whether these capabilities have been battle-tested at enterprise scale. Based on the company’s own website and other marketing materials, its customer base is mostly smaller merchants and medium-sized businesses, which rarely deal with the same volume and complexity of chargebacks as larger organizations. Justt Justt’s end-to-end automation is the solution of choice for numerous Fortune 500 enterprises and fintech giants. This is because Justt’s combination of A/B testing, AI-driven representment building, and automated evidence collection are not only volume agnostic, but drive quality disputes even during chargeback surges. The system is also continuously refined and improved to meet the demands of high-volume merchants in diverse industries – including Fiverr, DoorDash, Best Buy and others – making Justt uniquely suited for high-scale scenarios. 2. Custom AI-crafted responses that adjust argument style, type, order, formatting, and more, to the demands of every case. The system generates automated responses but may not fully adapt to the nuances of different industries or complex dispute scenarios. Justt Justt has been the first to market and is the leader in AI-driven, bespoke chargeback responses. Justt’s Dynamic Arguments feature creates nuanced arguments for every dispute. Fighting low-value or low-probability chargebacks can eat into margins and inflate costs. jobs.title: Justt vs Chargebacks911
jobs.description: Skip to content Blog Guides Justt vs Chargebacks911: Understanding the Alternatives Today’s record levels of friendly fraud mean that choosing a reliable and scalable chargeback automation and management solution has never been more essential. This article compares two of the most dominant players in the chargeback space, with an offering that focuses on serving larger merchants or enterprises. We’ll be comparing Justt and Chargebacks911 – and will examine how each addresses the most important capabilities that modern merchants require in a chargeback automation solution. This article is based on the information we have gathered from online research and from discussions with previous and current Chargebacks911 customers. While we have made every attempt to present the facts accurately, we welcome any critical feedback and will revise any inaccuracies that are pointed out to us. The TL;DR – Key Differences: Approach to automation: Justt offers end-to-end AI automation with Dynamic Arguments that tailor each dispute according to available data, reason codes, industry and more while Chargebacks911 static templates and some manual work, that may make it difficult to scale during high-volume periods. Third-party data sources for compelling evidence: Justt accesses hundreds of third-party data points for evidence enrichment, compared to Chargebacks911’s focus on basic PSP and merchant data. Integrations: Justt integrates with 50+ payment service providers, compared to Chargebacks911’s more limited integrations. Optimization and analytics: Justt provides continuous A/B testing, machine learning optimization, and predictive forecasting capabilities, while Chargebacks911 lacks advanced analytics and forecasting features. Setup and scalability: Justt offers near-instant setup, while Chargebacks911’s hybrid manual approach may require longer implementation times for complex merchant environments. About Justt and Chargebacks911 Founded in 2011, Chargebacks911 is one of the oldest chargeback solution providers on the market, and one of few that formerly operated with a fully manual service model, submitting representments manually on behalf of merchants. Despite now offering basic automation features, their continued reliance on manual representment building and static templates may now present scalability challenges and missed optimization opportunities for modern merchants. Justt (full disclosure: that’s us) has pioneered the world’s first end-to-end automated chargeback management solution, using advanced AI to conduct evidence collection, representment building, continuous optimization, and predictive analytics. The platform uses Dynamic Arguments to create precision-tailored responses where every detail is adjusted to meet the demands of the individual issuers reviewing the case, maximizing chances of success. Justt’s fully automated approach removes the scalability limitations inherent in manual processes, allowing the platform to handle volume surges effortlessly while continuously improving win rates through A/B testing. Comparison of Critical Capabilities With so many bells whistles, and expensive add-ons available, it’s hard to know which chargeback mitigation features are necessary and what you can do without. To reduce the confusion, we’ve broken chargeback management solutions down into ten essential components that every system should handle fluidly. Let’s see how Justt and Chargebacks911 measure up. 1. Automated Responses: Scale With Volume and Deliver High-Quality Disputes Only end-to-end automation can consistently maintain response quality during high volume periods and reduce labor costs during quiet spells. Look for solutions that explain exactly how and where they apply automation – ideally, this should cover evidence collection from the merchant, PSP and 3rd party data sources, representment building, submission, and continuous optimization. Chargebacks911 Chargebacks911 employs a human-centric, template-based approach that requires manual involvement to complete each representment. Despite introducing basic automation to certain workflows, this hybrid approach creates inherent scalability challenges such as bottlenecks and delays during surges – just when consistent coverage is most critical. Justt Justt’s platform has pioneered end-to-end automation in chargeback management. Every aspect of dispute handling – from initial assessment through evidence compilation and submission – operates automatically. This approach ensures that quality never drops during high volume periods, whether processing ten disputes or ten thousand. In fact, comprehensive A/B testing means that the solution’s output continues to improve with every representment. 2. Use of Dynamic Arguments Many chargeback solutions rely on static templates, versus Justt’s approach which is built around Dynamic Arguments. Chargebacks911 Chargebacks911’s template-based system represents an increasingly outmoded approach to dispute management.
